title: BKN-PAL V1.0
description: The Data Type exchanged between Basic Knowledge and Personality Alignment (Deliberation Exchange) through the Model Context Protocol. It has two modes, told apart by Mode: Request (RQ), sent by Basic Knowledge, that asks for the personality-aligned stance, and Response (RS), sent by Personality Alignment, that supplies the selected stance. The exchanges of one dialogue are told apart by TurnIndex within the DialogID.

QueryID.description: Identifier of this Request or Response.

RequestID.description: Response only. ID of the Request this Response answers.

DialogID.description: Identifier of the dialogue (the Model Context Protocol session) to which the exchange belongs.

TurnIndex.description: Ordinal position of the exchange in the dialogue, starting from 0. A Response has the TurnIndex of its Request.

Question.description: Request only. The question of Basic Knowledge about the stance, in natural language.

Constraints.description: Request only. Constraints that Basic Knowledge asks the stance to satisfy.

Stance.description: Response only. The personality-aligned stance of the A-User, with its role and locale constraints.
